name: chalette-dev
description: Chalette internal dev & QA toolkit for Command Room. v0.4.0 (2026-07-24) — TI2: triage-intake gains a route-work-out mode. On a may_ship operator profile ONLY, an item whose triage verdict is SPEC and which passes the five-clause contributor-suitability test (target repo is cr1; fully specifiable from repo contents; buildable and testable against the battery + synthetic fixtures alone; zero client/org/person names needed anywhere including PR text; zero ship authority) now yields two additional outputs: a self-contained packet at <specs_dir>/packets/PACKET_<TAG>.md that a cold fork contributor can execute without the maintainer online (handoff header, a spec body shaped per cr1's checked-in templates/TEMPLATE_SPEC.md with §0 already ruled, kickoff prompt, acceptance incl. the scrub AC verbatim, and an explicit PR-description-requirements block carrying the TEMPLATE_BUILD_REPORT slots), and one scrubbed READY row staged onto a repo-root BACKLOG.md in the cr1 clone that the contributor can read from their fork. Both outbound surfaces pass a FAIL-CLOSED scrub gate first: the new scrub_roster operator key (committed default null, real value overlay-only) is grepped against the full outbound text, and a null/unreadable roster REFUSES both writes with an explicit reason line rather than emitting unscrubbed text — the org-name-leak class cannot ride cr1's G9 alone, whose first-name dictionary cannot know real ORG names. BACKLOG writes are STAGE-AND-SHOW: git add + show the staged diff in the closing decision table, then stop — a triage session ends with zero new commits in the cr1 clone, and the maintainer pushes in his own ship window. The closing decision table gains an Eric? column. Zero trigger changes: the frontmatter description is byte-identical to v0.3.1, both features are inert behind the may_ship gate on a contractor profile, and INTAKE1 F1/F5 are untouched. Skill count unchanged (16). PRIOR HISTORY: Chalette internal dev & QA toolkit for Command Room. v0.3.1 (2026-07-24) — MAINT2: maintenance batch. (1) FIX: the operator-profile resolution pattern no longer silently no-ops under Git Bash on Windows (SHIP_RECORD_CONSOL2 finding 3, pattern-wide across all 11 reading skills). The bash blocks built the plugin root from ${BASH_SOURCE[0]} — empty when an agent runs a SKILL.md block through a Bash tool — and from pwd, which yields an MSYS path (/c/Users/...) that native python.exe resolves to C:\c\Users\..., so BOTH config reads missed, the merged profile came back empty, and every skill fell through to its synthetic default with no error: an operator granted allowed_targets [real] silently ran synthetic. The canonical preamble now searches for config/operator.json (with a $CHALETTE_DEV_ROOT escape hatch, never a hardcoded machine path), converts with cygpath -m, and FAILS LOUD on an unreadable root or profile; the python-form skills carry the same loud fence plus the native-path contract for SKILL_PLUGIN_ROOT. Guard 2 gains Fence 4 (+29 tests, 24 -> 53; 51 after the two retirements drop their quick_validate cases): the shipped preamble is EXECUTED out of each SKILL.md and asserted to read a non-empty profile, mutation-verified both ways. (2) RETIRED compare-canonical-vs-freelance — its niche (validating the v3.13.8 §3.6 canonical-vs-freelance widget ladder per skill) is closed; the freelance fallback it diffed against no longer exists, and synthetic invariant I2 (no_freelance_render) asserts the property the diff was inferring; ship-readiness-gate's coverage claims were corrected rather than inherited (Bug #48 action-label drift is cr1's CanonicalActionError validator in the unit tier, not this gate). (3) FOLDED run-command-room-tests into cr-test — it never had a delegating caller, and its hardcoded five suites were long superseded by tests/run_all.py's call-time discovery; its trigger phrases ('internal: run plugin tests', 'run command room tests', 'command room health check', 'verify plugin code') are now aliases for 'cr test --quick' in cr-test's description. Skill count 18 -> 16. PRIOR HISTORY: Chalette internal dev & QA toolkit for Command Room. v0.3.0 (2026-07-24) — CONSOL1: chalette-dev becomes the SINGLE canonical home of the shared QA/dev toolkit; the duplicate copies were removed from the private chalette plugin (which drifted).
